nodes.name: Sklearn Cluster Bicluster Piecewise Projection Helper Atoms
nodes.description: Deterministic spectral biclustering helpers for piecewise vector reconstruction, residual scoring, best-vector selection, and dense projection before the deferred KMeans assignment step.

nodes.name: bicluster_piecewise_vector

nodes.complexity_reasoning: Dimensionality reduction or sparse coding decomposes high-dimensional features, taking quadratic time in features and linear in samples.
